description.full: Answers Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Cowork, Microsoft Copilot Autopilot, Copilot Studio, agent governance and Copilot FinOps questions, and checks every setting, credit rate, status and date against Microsoft Learn, the Microsoft Copilot Roadmap, Message Center and official Microsoft blogs before stating it.
